# CNN
> CNN is a global news organization covering breaking news, analysis, video, and live reporting across major world topics.

CNN publishes reporting and explainers across U.S. and world news, politics, business, health, science, climate, sports, style, travel, and entertainment. The site also includes live TV and video, audio and podcasts, newsletters, and topic hubs for major ongoing stories.

## Main News
- [CNN Homepage](https://www.cnn.com/): Top stories, breaking news, featured reporting, and live updates across all coverage areas.
- [U.S. News](https://www.cnn.com/us): National news, crime, courts, disasters, and major developments across the United States.
- [World](https://www.cnn.com/world): International reporting and regional coverage from Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
- [Opinion](https://www.cnn.com/opinions): Commentary and analysis from CNN contributors and guest writers on current events.
- [Audio](https://www.cnn.com/audio): Podcasts, audio briefings, and on-demand listening from CNN shows and series.
- [Video](https://www.cnn.com/videos): News clips, interviews, explainers, and live or featured video coverage.

## Politics
- [Politics](https://www.cnn.com/politics): U.S. politics coverage including Congress, the White House, campaigns, and policy debates.
- [Election Center](https://www.cnn.com/election): Election news, results, maps, polling, and race coverage during major election cycles.
- [Supreme Court](https://www.cnn.com/politics/supreme-court): Reporting and analysis on Supreme Court cases, rulings, and justices.
- [Fact Check](https://www.cnn.com/politics/factcheck): Fact-checking of political claims, speeches, ads, and public statements.
- [Congress](https://www.cnn.com/politics/congress): Coverage of legislation, leadership fights, hearings, and Capitol Hill negotiations.

## Business and Technology
- [Business](https://www.cnn.com/business): Business news covering markets, companies, the economy, media, and technology.
- [Markets](https://www.cnn.com/business/markets): Stock market coverage, investor news, and major moves affecting global markets.
- [Tech](https://www.cnn.com/business/tech): Technology reporting on AI, platforms, devices, cybersecurity, and digital policy.
- [Media](https://www.cnn.com/business/media): News about media companies, streaming, journalism, and the entertainment business.
- [Economy](https://www.cnn.com/business/economy): Inflation, jobs, consumer trends, and macroeconomic developments affecting households and businesses.

## Health, Science, and Climate
- [Health](https://www.cnn.com/health): Medical news, wellness guidance, public health reporting, and disease coverage.
- [Wellness](https://www.cnn.com/health/wellness): Everyday health, sleep, fitness, nutrition, and mental well-being advice.
- [Science](https://www.cnn.com/science): Discoveries, research, space exploration, and science explainers from around the world.
- [Space](https://www.cnn.com/science/space): NASA missions, launches, astronomy, and commercial spaceflight coverage.
- [Climate](https://www.cnn.com/climate): Climate change reporting, extreme weather links, policy developments, and environmental impacts.
- [Weather](https://www.cnn.com/weather): Forecasts, severe weather alerts, hurricanes, wildfires, and storm tracking updates.

## World Regions and Conflict Coverage
- [Europe](https://www.cnn.com/world/europe): News and analysis from European countries, institutions, and regional crises.
- [Asia](https://www.cnn.com/world/asia): Reporting on politics, business, disasters, and society across Asia.
- [Middle East](https://www.cnn.com/world/middleeast): Coverage of regional politics, conflicts, diplomacy, and humanitarian developments.
- [Africa](https://www.cnn.com/world/africa): News from across Africa covering politics, business, culture, and conflict.
- [Americas](https://www.cnn.com/world/americas): Reporting from Latin America, Canada, and the wider Americas region.
- [Ukraine](https://www.cnn.com/world/europe/ukraine): Ongoing reporting on Russia’s war in Ukraine and related global developments.

## Sports and Entertainment
- [Sport](https://www.cnn.com/sport): International sports coverage including football, tennis, golf, motorsport, and Olympics news.
- [Football](https://www.cnn.com/sport/football): Global football coverage including major leagues, tournaments, and player news.
- [Tennis](https://www.cnn.com/sport/tennis): Tournament results, player interviews, rankings, and match analysis.
- [Entertainment](https://www.cnn.com/entertainment): Celebrity, film, television, music, and culture industry reporting.
- [Style](https://www.cnn.com/style): Fashion, design, architecture, art, and luxury lifestyle coverage.

## Travel and Lifestyle
- [Travel](https://www.cnn.com/travel): Destination features, aviation news, travel advice, and global tourism stories.
- [Food and Drink](https://www.cnn.com/travel/food-and-drink): Culinary travel stories, restaurant features, and food culture reporting.
- [Destinations](https://www.cnn.com/travel/destinations): Place-based travel guides and features from cities and regions worldwide.
- [Life, But Better](https://www.cnn.com/health/life-but-better): Practical lifestyle advice on relationships, habits, stress, and daily well-being.
- [Underscored](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-underscored): Product recommendations, reviews, and buying guides from CNN Underscored.

## Video, TV, and Audio
- [Live TV](https://www.cnn.com/tv): Access points for CNN live television programming and featured broadcast content.
- [CNN Max](https://www.cnn.com/cnn-max): Streaming news programming and show information for CNN Max viewers.
- [Shows A-Z](https://www.cnn.com/shows): Directory of CNN programs, anchors, and show pages.
- [CNN Originals](https://www.cnn.com/shows/cnn-originals): Documentary and long-form original series from CNN.
- [Podcasts](https://www.cnn.com/audio/podcasts): Podcast lineup including daily news, interviews, and narrative series.

## Features and Services
- [Newsletters](https://www.cnn.com/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major topics, briefings, and curated CNN reporting.
- [Live Updates](https://www.cnn.com/live-news): Rolling live blogs for major breaking news events and developing stories.
- [Photos](https://www.cnn.com/photos): Photo galleries documenting news events, features, and visual storytelling.
- [Listen](https://www.cnn.com/audio/live): Live audio streams and listening options for CNN audio coverage.
- [Games](https://www.cnn.com/games): Puzzles and games including crosswords, sudoku, and other daily challenges.
